text:
Maya: Quick heads-up: bring-up numbers for Topiary v1.2 (256-d, quant6 per-channel). Throughput +1.7x vs fp16, but recall@10 on wiki-holdout dropped by ~4.2% vs baseline. throwing this here for visibility.
Juan: Can you paste the exact numbers and which splits? rough delta is fine.
Maya: baseline recall@10 = 0.872 -> topiary-quant6 = 0.830. silhouette (avg cluster cohesion) down 0.05. mean cosine shift ~0.018. affected mainly long-tail and short-query cohorts.
Sam: ugh. throughput win is nice but 4pts recall is big. any neighbor-consensus or anchor-flip stats?
Anya: ran neighbor-consensus last night (k=10): anchor-flip rate ~9% (anchors that changed >50% of top10). long-tail cohorts had ~12% flips. short queries (<=8 tokens) saw biggest drop.
Maya: uploaded quick UMAP snapshots to dashboards (link: internal/report/Topiary-v1.2-umap). you can see anchor drift around a few dense clusters.
Sam: recommend triage plan: 1) run per-tensor int6 sweep, 2) try post-quant calibration (per-channel scale recalib), 3) test cosine-normalize before indexing and re-run recall@k, 4) run neighbor-consensus at k=1,5,10 to profile flips. I'll kick off (1) and (4).
ci-bot: embed-eval pipeline triggered by @Sam: job id e-8721. Tests: wiki-holdout, short/long cohorts, metrics=[recall@1,recall@5,recall@10,neighbor-consensus,silhouette]. ETA ~30m.
Juan: also check indexing distance metric: L2 vs cosine makes a difference for quant noise. did we build indices with raw vectors or normalized?
Anya: current index built from raw vectors (no norm). preliminary normalization (unit L2) recovered ~1.6% recall on a quick sample.
Maya: good to know. other low-friction mitigations: - enable prefix KV caching where applicable (not directly related but reduces latency headroom for hybrid configs) - try hybrid-index where anchors stored fp16 while rest quantized (we tested this pattern in earlier models).
Sam: running sweep now: command I'm using:
```
./tools/embed-eval \
  --model topiary:v1.2 \
  --quant perchannel6 \
  --holdout wiki \
  --cohorts short,long,tail \
  --metrics recall@1,recall@5,recall@10,neighbor-consensus,silhouette \
  --seed 42
```
Anya: if sweep shows flips concentrated in k<=5 we might prefer index-time normalization + per-index rerank as a quick rollback path.
Maya: decision for now: don't promote Topiary-quant6 to staging traffic. Sam to post sweep results in thread. if per-tensor6 or normalization recovers >2% recall we'll re-evaluate canary.
Juan: thanks. ping me if you want me to run the hybrid-index smoke on dedicated nodes.
Sam: will post results in ~35m. :thumbsup:
Maya: appreciate it. we'll sync tomorrow at 10am PT in #eng-ml if we need a quick huddle.
